reviews.title: My Overall Review
reviews.comment:
This is my first review on Amazon and it is also my first PC Build. The reason why I got it was because I loved the look of the case. It is beautifully made and matched the aesthetic I wanted my first build to be. I went with a minimal RGB and all black component build and I loved it. Although the size is noticeably larger (both height and length) than the old my Micro ATX case. If large size is an issue for you, maybe don’t get this case. Airflow is something I am not well versed on. I seen online and YouTube videos on the issues of airflow this case has and it’s negative pressure airflow design. I wouldn’t also recommend the original fan configuration because it is not optimal for good airflow. If you cannot buy more fans; I would highly suggest to switch the front two from exhaust to intake. Although I completely removed the original fans and bought Be Quiet! Pure Wings 3 Reverse to replace them. Cable Management in this case is amazing, although I wouldn’t be able to compare to other cases due to this being my first pc build. I love the many hooks and ways you can attach zip ties or cables around the case to make it neatly. This case is quiet, beautiful, and aesthetic. I did not regret buying this case for my first build. I love how big the case is for future and larger GPU upgrades. Also the curved glass on the black variant of the case is noticeably tinted. I gave this case 5 stars due to the design, look, ease of cable management, and size for future upgradability. I would recommend getting this case to anyone yet again, it is your build and your vision. So in the end of the day, how do you want your pc to look or function? Especially that we are dropping thousands of dollars to make our build a reality. This is how I wanted my first build pc to look and I did not regret it at all.
Build:
Case: ASUS Prime AP202 ARGB Black
Ram: Crucial Pro DDR5 RAM 32GB, 6400 MHz CL32
PSU: be quiet! Pure Power 13 M 850W Power Supply, 80 Plus Gold
CPU Cooler: Thermalright Phantom Spirit 120 SE Black
CPU: Ryzen 9 9900X
MOBO: ASUS Tuff Gaming B850-Plus WiFi
GPU: Gigabyte Radeon RX 9060 XT Gaming OC 16Gb

reviews.title: Solid case, albeit a bit large for mATX, but beautiful looking!
reviews.comment:
Case is clean, assembly is relatively easy. Big for a mATX case, but that's why I ordered it. Supports 360mm AIO's and full length GPUs. Cable management is actually much better than expected.
Be careful if you have an older card, I have a 3080 and it's thick, so the clearance from the bottom is probably half an inch to 3/4ths of an inch. I had to adjust my PSU cables to not snag on the GPU fans but that was a simple fix.
